10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10781|cb1093ae.name: Royal Overseer Bauhaus
10781|cb1093ae.text: I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.

11071|9e99182c.name: Mot Dawnstrider
11071|9e99182c.text: I cannot teach you anything you don't already know. However, the knowledge of my father far surpasses my own. Go inside and speak to him. Good luck!

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

14754|17e0e2bb.name: Kelm Hargunth
14754|17e0e2bb.text: Zug zug, my friend!  I am Kelm Hargunth, the main supplier for the Warsong Outriders.  As you improve your standing with the Outriders, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you can use inside Warsong Gulch.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

14781|ae99f5b7.name: Captain Shatterskull
14781|ae99f5b7.text: It is no easy task to protect the Horde's lumber gathering efforts here in Ashenvale, but we have never shied from battle!  The night elves and their allies will fall!

15012|c09ac14a.name: Javnir Nashak
15012|c09ac14a.text:
Greetings, $c.  It is the time of the Harvest Festival - a time of great bounties and a time of remembrance.  We partake of feasts to celebrate all we have to be thankful of, and we remember our ancestors and past heroes to give thanks to the legacy they gave us.

Please feel free to partake of the feast being offered here.  Also, I am offering some fireworks to help celebrate this joyous time of year.

248202|055d4e51.name: Jim'bek
248202|055d4e51.text:
<Jim'bek locks eyes with you as he takes a deep puff from his hookah.>

'Ello, mon. Need a rug? A blanket? Or just some cloth for your next project? I got you.

263646|fb408f08.name: Rugbul Boomfirst
263646|fb408f08.text: Well, well...are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?

271613|cd85d6bf.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|cd85d6bf.text:
<Othmar's head looks at you from nearby.>

What... You... Want...

Filthy... $r...

2804|cda4c0c1.name: Kurden Bloodclaw
2804|cda4c0c1.text: Are you here to fight for us at Warsong Gulch?  Lok'tar Ogar $c!

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3011|dab22e8f.name: Teg Dawnstrider
3011|dab22e8f.text: I will teach you... soon. I require a demonstration of your loyalty, first.

3084|8ecf23b9.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|8ecf23b9.text: None are as skilled in the use of weapons as Ansekhwa.  It is said that he is guided by the spirits of the finest warriors of our honored ancestors.  Seek him out on the lower rise and he will teach you what you want to know.

3171|9d35dc4d.name: Thotar
3171|9d35dc4d.text: I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3324|031480cd.name: Grol'dar
3324|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3326|86b6c1ef.name: Zevrost
3326|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

3373|1355f2b7.name: Arnok
3373|1355f2b7.text: I am an $r of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3406|08830bac.name: Xor'juul
3406|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3406|08e320c2.name: Xor'juul
3406|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3433|ac5dfa0b.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|ac5dfa0b.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and $r cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3682|960c6ca2.name: Vrang Wildgore
3682|960c6ca2.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

4613|c46004b8.name: Christopher Drakul
4613|c46004b8.text: Welcome to the Undercity Guild Registry. What do you want?

5624|89fbd152.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|89fbd152.text: Archibald who you look for.  He outside weapon merchant shop on inner ring of War Quarter.

5815|721fd095.name: Kurgul
5815|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

1492-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-complete.text:
A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.

All taken care of! Good day to you, $c.
1492-complete.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1492-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-progress.text: You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?
1492-progress.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

5041-complete.name: Thork
5041-complete.text: Haha! Thank you, $N! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
5041-complete.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5722-complete.name: Rahauro
5722-complete.text:
The body looks seriously beaten by clubs or fists, but most of the corpse's clothing and equipment still looks present. It seems the troggs do not overly care much for material wealth.

You begin to search the body for anything of interest that might help Magatha.
5722-complete.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5724-accept.name: Unknown
5724-accept.text:
You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.

Removing the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
5724-accept.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

6282-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-accept.text:
Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.

The Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.

I need you to cull the harpies, $N!
6282-accept.title: Harpies Threaten

6301-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-accept.text:
Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

$N, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
6301-accept.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6365-complete.name: Devrak
6365-complete.text: You have to get this meat to Orgrimmar?  That is no problem.  For a small fee, my wind rider can take you there.
6365-complete.title: Meats to Orgrimmar

6365-progress.name: Devrak
6365-progress.text: You need to get somewhere fast?  Then you're talking to the right $r!
6365-progress.title: Meats to Orgrimmar

6384-accept.name: Devrak
6384-accept.text:
For just a few coins I will have a wind rider bring you to Orgrimmar.  When you get there, you can take Zargh's Meats to Gryshka.  Her inn is in the Valley of Strength, not far from the Skytower, where my wind rider will drop you off.

Speak with me again when you are ready for the journey.
6384-accept.title: Ride to Orgrimmar

6384-complete.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6384-complete.text:
Oh, wonderful!  Those are fine cuts!  These are from Zargh, are they?  That $r sure knows his way into a lady's heart...

Oh, I can't wait to cook it.  But not too much!  Meat is best served rare, don't you think?
6384-complete.title: Ride to Orgrimmar

6384-progress.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6384-progress.text: Something smells good!  You don't have raw meat on you, do you?
6384-progress.title: Ride to Orgrimmar

6385-accept.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6385-accept.text:
I've written a letter of thanks to Zargh.  Will you deliver it for me?  If you've already been to the Crossroads and spoken with their wind rider master, then you can fly a wind rider back there.

Take my letter to Doras, the wind rider master of Orgrimmar, and speak with him about transport to the Crossroads.
6385-accept.title: Doras the Wind Rider Master

6385-complete.name: Doras
6385-complete.text: You have to get this to the Crossroads in the Barrens?  Yes, I can get you there...
6385-complete.title: Doras the Wind Rider Master

6385-progress.name: Doras
6385-progress.text: Do you need one of my wind riders?
6385-progress.title: Doras the Wind Rider Master

6386-accept.name: Doras
6386-accept.text:
My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.

You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here.  Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.

Speak with me when you are ready to go.
6386-accept.title: Return to the Crossroads

79007-accept.name: Unknown
79007-accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007-accept.title: ... and that note you found

79007-complete.name: Unknown
79007-complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79007-complete.title: ... and that note you found

79192-accept.name: Unknown
79192-accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192-accept.title: Stepping Stones

79192-complete.name: Unknown
79192-complete.text: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
79192-complete.title: Stepping Stones

79974-accept.name: Unknown
79974-accept.text:
"Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time. 
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for."
79974-accept.title: Wet Job

79975-accept.name: Unknown
79975-accept.text:
<You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox.>

"From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
79975-accept.title: Eagle's Fist

79975-complete.name: Unknown
79975-complete.text: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.
79975-complete.title: Eagle's Fist

79976-accept.name: Unknown
79976-accept.text:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

<The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
79976-accept.title: This Must Be The Place

79976-complete.name: Unknown
79976-complete.text: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.
79976-complete.title: This Must Be The Place

79980-accept.name: Unknown
79980-accept.text: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
79980-accept.title: Scramble

79980-complete.name: Unknown
79980-complete.text: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.
79980-complete.title: Scramble

809-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
809-accept.text:
Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in $r society.  The collar you brought me confirms my fears.

It belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power.  It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the Barrens atop Dreadmist Peak.  It must be destroyed!

Go to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth.  He will direct you further.
809-accept.title: Ak'Zeloth

809-complete.name: Ak'Zeloth
809-complete.text:
Neeru wants the Demon Seed destroyed, does he?  Strange...

Very well.  If he wishes the seed gone, then I will tell you how to remove it.
809-complete.title: Ak'Zeloth

819-accept.name: Unknown
819-accept.text:
A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,

"Chen Stormstout-

May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
819-accept.title: Chen's Empty Keg

829-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
829-complete.text:
Ah, and where did you get this?  Good Margoz in Razor Hill sent you to me, did he?

Well, let me take a closer look...
829-complete.title: Neeru Fireblade

829-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
829-progress.text: My most humble greetings, $c.  How might I help my $r brother today?
829-progress.title: Neeru Fireblade

832-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
832-complete.text:
<Examines the Eye of Burning Shadow.>

Intriguing.  The voice you heard mentioned my name?  I am known for hunting down enemies of our Warchief, but...it is strange that I was singled out.  Stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists from whom you recovered this pendant have a name so close to my own.

I must study this pendant.  I must study and, and must ponder the meaning of its message.

Thank you for bringing this to my attention, $N.  You have done your people a great service.
832-complete.title: Burning Shadows

832-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
832-progress.text: You have something vital to report.  I can sense it behind your eyes.
832-progress.title: Burning Shadows

844-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-complete.text: Very good, $N.  With the plainstriders gone we'll have an easier time keeping our supply chains intact.  And I hope you learned a few tricks out there in the Barrens, for your next prey has a little more fire in its blood than the plainstriders...
844-complete.title: Plainstrider Menace

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-accept.text:
The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders.  Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.

Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves.  Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
845-accept.title: The Zhevra

850-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead.  And those are the most dangerous.

Barak was such a centaur.  It is good that he is dead.
850-complete.title: Kolkar Leaders

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

851-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
851-accept.text:
The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find.  But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  It may be possible to draw him to you.

Travel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent.  It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm.  And Verog will come.

Bring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.
851-accept.title: Verog the Dervish

86576-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
86576-accept.text:
In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
86576-accept.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

867-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-accept.text:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
867-accept.title: Harpy Raiders

867-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-complete.text: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $N. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
867-complete.title: Harpy Raiders

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

868-accept.name: Korran
868-accept.text:
Hey, $N. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
868-accept.title: Egg Hunt

871-complete.name: Thork
871-complete.text: You have done well, $N. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
871-complete.title: Disrupt the Attacks

872-accept.name: Thork
872-accept.text:
One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, $N. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.

To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
872-accept.title: The Disruption Ends

875-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-accept.text:
Hahaha, $N. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.

Make sure they die painfully, $N. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
875-accept.title: Harpy Lieutenants

878-accept.name: Mangletooth
878-accept.text:
You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
878-accept.title: Tribes at War

887-accept.name: Gazlowe
887-accept.text:
I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
887-accept.title: Southsea Freebooters

891-accept.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-accept.text:
Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
891-accept.title: The Guns of Northwatch

893-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-accept.text:
The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.

If you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
893-accept.title: Weapons of Choice

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

894-complete.name: Unknown
894-complete.text: A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
894-complete.title: Samophlange

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

899-accept.name: Mankrik
899-accept.text:
Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, $c. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.

You, $c--you  could help me.

Kill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
899-accept.title: Consumed by Hatred

900-accept.name: Unknown
900-accept.text: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
900-accept.title: Samophlange

900-complete.name: Unknown
900-complete.text: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
900-complete.title: Samophlange

901-accept.name: Unknown
901-accept.text: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
901-accept.title: Samophlange

901-complete.name: Unknown
901-complete.text: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
901-complete.title: Samophlange

901-progress.name: Unknown
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-accept.name: Unknown
902-accept.text: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
902-accept.title: Samophlange

924-accept.name: Ak'Zeloth
924-accept.text:
The Demon Seed is a powerful tool for the Burning Legion. It rests in a cave on Dreadmist Peak, above a demonic altar of fire.

I have prepared power stones that when placed near the Seed will disrupt its connection to the Legion.

Take a stone from the table and bring it to the altar of fire atop Dreadmist Peak. Travel west, then north when the road forks. The Peak will be to your left. The safest climb to the top is on its northern face.

And hurry--the stone's power will consume itself in time.
924-accept.title: The Demon Seed

924-complete.name: Ak'Zeloth
924-complete.text:
Your task is complete.  You have destroyed the Demon Seed as Neeru bid.  But this is not the end...

The destruction of the Demon Seed sent waves of power through the ether, waves of staggering force.  I felt them, and I am sure other beings did as well.  Others who will wonder why their toy was broken...

But regardless of future troubles, I have something for you.  Neeru sent it as payment.  And he bid me thank you.

So, thank you.
924-complete.title: The Demon Seed

926-complete.name: Unknown
926-complete.text: These stones are infused with magical energy, but purposefully flawed.  They are very unstable and once removed from the table they will consume themselves quickly.
926-complete.title: Flawed Power Stone

95216-complete.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.

Get out of my sight!
95216-complete.title: The New Plague

95216-progress.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-progress.text:
Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.

I must see this strain for myself!
95216-progress.title: The New Plague

95494-accept.name: Vrang Wildgore
95494-accept.text:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494-accept.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95494-complete.name: Vrang Wildgore
95494-complete.text:
Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade. 

I've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.
95494-complete.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95495-accept.name: Vrang Wildgore
95495-accept.text:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495-accept.title: The Hermit Tanner

95495-complete.name: Walton
95495-complete.text: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
95495-complete.title: The Hermit Tanner

95495-progress.name: Walton
95495-progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?
95495-progress.title: The Hermit Tanner

95507-accept.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-accept.text:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
95507-accept.title: Vrang's Game

95507-complete.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.
95507-complete.title: Vrang's Game

95507-progress.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507-progress.title: Vrang's Game

95508-accept.name: Walton
95508-accept.text:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508-accept.title: Unwelcome Guests

95508-complete.name: Walton
95508-complete.text:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but its the least I can do.

Safe travels, $c.
95508-complete.title: Unwelcome Guests

95621-accept.name: Walton
95621-accept.text:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
95621-accept.title: Trouble in the Valley

95621-complete.name: Walton
95621-complete.text: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
95621-complete.title: Trouble in the Valley

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley

96875-complete.name: Kamari
96875-complete.text: Your work helps Orgrimmar grow. Know that as you walk the city's paths.
96875-complete.title: Beasts of Thunder Ridge

96877-complete.name: Kamari
96877-complete.text: What a trophy, $c! That must have been some fight!
96877-complete.title: Halikor's Hoof

97250-accept.name: Grunt Logmar
97250-accept.text:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
97250-accept.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

97288-accept.name: Unknown
97288-accept.text:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288-accept.title: Unending Torment

97288-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97288-complete.text:
Oho! I believe I know this head. A cruel joke by our Dark Lady. A delicious one at that.

I think I have a use for this.
97288-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97289-accept.text:
We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the alliance once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching of this one herself.

Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.

Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
97289-accept.title: Unending Torment

97289-complete.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-complete.text:
<The body twitches to life, panicking as it relives its final moments.>

You...
97289-complete.title: Unending Torment

97289-progress.name: Unfinished Abomination
97289-progress.text: <The abomination remains lifeless without a head to control it.>
97289-progress.title: Unending Torment

97290-accept.name: Unfinished Abomination
97290-accept.text:
You... abomination...

Why should... help you...

Be gone...
97290-accept.title: Unending Torment

97290-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97290-complete.text: Not cooperating, eh? Excellent. I always love a challenge.
97290-complete.title: Unending Torment

97291-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
97291-accept.text:
With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.

We simply need to motivate it.

Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.

We have a potion to make!
97291-accept.title: Unending Torment

99052-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-complete.text:
Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!

Be proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
99052-complete.title: Threat from Below
